degradations.reason: The adapter recognizes the title but the Agent Snapshot has no title field.
Unknown injected sources remain visible as diagnostics instead of impersonating the user; known plugin, skill-catalog, and agent-instructions context is consumed without a Timeline item.

Native direct children have service-gated independent live/prepared observations and provider-scoped plugin attachment. Only live continuable children with matching resident lifecycle and native interruptByParent support cancel. Input/steer/queue/settings/commands remain unavailable; saved and one-shot views cannot cancel. Observer disposal never closes native work.
Native start/end identity is paired; only success emits completed. Failure and interruption emit errors because the public compaction item has no failed terminal replacement state.
Codex thread names remain native session metadata because the Agent Snapshot has no title field.
Codex terminal interactions remain native command side-channel activity because normalized tool detail has no process ID, stdin, or progress fields.
Only flat losslessly representable primitive forms are supported. Unsupported constraints, nested schemas, and sensitive defaults are explicitly declined.
Pending native RPCs and synthesized plan approvals are process-local. Native cold resume does not reconstruct interaction receipts or resurrect resolved requests.

Direct native children support independent navigation and history on the owning app-server. Direct input controls require native canAcceptDirectInput; saved children are read-only and unavailable ephemeral history is rejected. Generic spawn/stop/resume orchestration is not exposed.

Direct native children expose independent read-only history and live observation. Existing live projections do not insert missed historical prefixes. Independent child input, cancellation and approval are not exposed; permissions stay with the owning parent.

Root sessions expose bounded embedded PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP tool-result bytes with immutable resource references. No path/URL fetching, uploads or child resources. Native JSON requires unambiguous tool-result ownership.

Public native model/permission setters, typed plan review and skill/compact commands are supported. Live effort has no public setter. Priority input may outlive the active turn and survive public interrupt; steer/queue remain disabled.
Pending permission callbacks are process-local. Native transcript resume does not revive unanswered callbacks or an in-progress turn.
An initialized Query remains in the Host directory before its first native transcript write; an empty session may not survive Host restart.

The pinned native CLI drops pattern/multipleOf and sensitive markers before onElicitation while retaining defaults. Form and unverified URL completion mappings remain disabled; no partial-schema workaround is advertised.
Public SDK model, skills, commands, tasks, metadata, permissions, interruptMainTurn and eventLog APIs are experimental; only CLI 1.0.83 is native-loopback verified. No ACP or private RPC transport.

Model catalog is native/auth dependent and changes require idle state. Deferred writes remain unconfirmed until native application. Effort is creation-only; planning and permission-mode controls are unavailable.

Children are task/eventLog views under the loaded parent. Repeated task input and cancellation are supported; approvals/questions stay on parent. No independent child queue, settings, resources, cold root resume or external spawn API.

SDK question callbacks omit native request/agent IDs. Only unique complete-payload event matches bind; identical concurrent unbound questions fail explicitly. Pending callbacks are process-local; no sensitivity/form/plan/grant/external-action mapping.
Tool output is bounded native text; skill Markdown uses refreshed native locators and bounded regular-file reads. Output images, todos, context capacity, cost and terminal control are not mapped.
SDK immediate input may become native queued delivery after the active interaction has ended. Native interactionId/delivery determine public turn grouping; adapter does not synthesize a queue.
